title: ÆTHER: Midnight City (modern founder drama main theme)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: ONE single modern cinematic main theme for a young founder's story in a big modern Indian city at night: lonely and restless at 2 AM, ending in confident triumph at sunrise. Today's sound, glossy, fresh and modern: deep 808 sub bass, punchy half-time drums with crisp trap hi-hats, analog synth arpeggios, a bright synth lead, clean electric piano, electric guitar, wide modern mix. Written the way today's South Indian film composers write: the whole track is built on ONE memorable melody that returns again and again; nothing unrelated is introduced, it grows only through sound and energy, one continuous story. Raga Charukesi (a Mixolydian flat-six scale) in D: D E F# G A Bb C. The melody starts bright on D E F# G, then leans on the flat sixth Bb and falls Bb A G F# with an ache; rising phrases climb A Bb C D. Sung-style phrasing with gamakam: slides into notes, a shake on F# and Bb, grace notes, the synth lead bends like a voice. Modal on a D pedal, few chord changes, no Western pop chord loop. The voice: a soft, close, natural wordless female humming voice (mm and aa) carries the melody. Real bansuri flute and a light tabla, played by real musicians, close, dry and natural, no heavy echo, not chopped. A separate electronic layer: a chopped glitching veena answering phrases, a pitched-down mridangam as an extra low hit, a reversed veena swell before the drop. One steady tempo, 88 BPM half-time feel, never stopping. 0-8 s: only a soft synth pulse and a clean electric piano playing a rising 3-note call D F A with the last note bent up, 2 AM in an empty glass office. 8-20 s: the female humming sings the melody softly over a deep 808 hum. 20-34 s: the half-time beat starts with trap hi-hats and a light tabla, rain and the night metro; the bansuri answers each humming phrase. 34-46 s: a synth arpeggio speeds up, the melody climbs, a reversed veena swell, the spark of an idea. 46-70 s: the full drop: the same melody on a bright synth lead with the humming and electric guitar, punchy drums and 808 bass, driving and confident. 70-82 s: the melody returns a whole step higher in E, the biggest moment, sunrise. 82-90 s: the beat drops away, the humming sings the first phrase once more, the electric piano ends on the 3-note call. Modern and urban, not old-fashioned, not a period film, no village or temple sounds, not a royal or hero march, no orchestral trailer drums, no silences, no gaps, no heavy echo on the flute or voice, no lyrics.
